about_short_description.short_description: Mentorcam gives people access to renowned experts and public figures for 1-on-1 mentorship and advice.

product.name: 1:1 Mentorship Video Calls
product.description: A service enabling users to book live, one-on-one video calls with startup founders and business leaders for personalized advice and mentorship.

product.name: Mentor Messaging Platform
product.description: A messaging system that allows users to communicate with mentors before and after calls, share agendas, upload files, and track progress securely on one platform.

product.name: Access to Expert Network
product.description: A service granting users on-demand access to a vetted network of startup founders and business professionals for mentorship and advice.
